title: Implicit Values Embedded in How Humans and LLMs Complete Subjective Everyday Tasks
reasoning: The paper explicitly audits and benchmarks LLMs on implicit values, including specific categories for 'religion' and 'morality'. It includes tasks such as distributing donations to different places of worship (ReligiousDonation) and editing email signatures containing quotes from various religious texts like the Quran, Bible, and Torah (EmailSignature).
